grammar.q: The volunteers brought a great deal of [ ____ ] to help the villagers rebuild the bridge.
Most first-time visitors find [ ____ ] hard to believe that the tiny island was once home to more than ten thousand people who made their living by fishing.
Of the two proposals submitted to the city council, one focused on public transportation, and [ ____ ] focused on bike lanes.
The new library, designed by a [ ____ ] known architect, attracts hundreds of visitors every weekend.
Many students who study abroad say that living alone in a foreign country teaches [ ____ ] to manage their own time, money, and emotions.
The heavy snowfall made the narrow mountain roads [ ____ ] for drivers without winter tires.
Historians have found [ ____ ] evidence to verify the claim that the ancient city was destroyed by an earthquake.
The hospital spent [ ____ ] money on better insulation for its crowded emergency room.
The city council considered [ ____ ] to close the old bridge until a thorough safety check was completed.
Although the instructions seemed [ ____ ] at first, most participants needed help with the final step.
The novelist, whose works have been translated into thirty languages, describes [ ____ ] as a shy person.
The streets in the old town are much narrower than [ ____ ] in the newly built districts.
The singer’s second album was [ ____ ] received by critics, who praised its honest and coherent lyrics.
Only [ ____ ] of the candidates had enough experience to be considered for the position.
The professor’s detailed [ ____ ] on our first attempts helped us improve the logic of our essays.
Archaeologists discovered several [ ____ ] suggesting that the island had been inhabited thousands of years earlier than previously believed.
[ ____ ] students from adjacent countries have applied for the new scholarship program, which covers tuition, housing, and travel expenses for four years.
Because the drought had lasted for months, the farmers had [ ____ ] water left to irrigate their fields.
The small family-run hotel prides [ ____ ] on providing courteous and friendly service to every guest, regardless of how long they stay or how much they pay for their rooms.
The museum guide asked the visitors not to touch the exhibits, but several children ignored [ ____ ] .
Each of the new apartments in the building comes with [ ____ ] own balcony and a small extra room.
Although the company’s snacks are popular among teenagers, [ ____ ] have been criticized by nutritionists for containing too much sugar.
According to a recent survey, the traffic in Seoul is much heavier than [ ____ ] in most other Asian capitals.
The houses built in the village after the war are much smaller than [ ____ ] built by wealthy merchants in the nineteenth century, when the port was thriving.
The museum owns two famous statues; one stands at the main entrance, and [ ____ ] is displayed beside the director’s office.
Some people believe that playing video games improves problem-solving skills, while [ ____ ] argue that it mainly wastes valuable study time.
The notorious old printer kept jamming, so the manager finally replaced it with a more compatible [ ____ ] .
Many international students find [ ____ ] to understand the local accent during their first semester abroad.
In her opening speech at the international symposium, the scientist made [ ____ ] clear that the results of the study were not yet ready to be published in a scientific journal.
The soup tasted [ ____ ] because the inexperienced cook had accidentally added too much of the dried herb.
Despite the long delay and the imminent storm, the passengers remained [ ____ ] and waited patiently for the next announcement.
The documentary about melting glaciers was [ ____ ] praised by scientists for its accurate explanations.
The government’s new housing policy made apartments more [ ____ ] for young couples and other renters who had been paying high rents for tiny rooms near their workplaces.
The engineers worked [ ____ ] for months to finish the highway project before the rainy season began.
The mountain village was so remote that it [ ____ ] ever received visitors from the city, even during the summer vacation.
Prices of fresh vegetables have risen sharply [ ____ ] , mainly because of the unusually low rainfall in the southern regions.
It is [ ____ ] unlikely that the old stadium will be repaired before the international competition scheduled for next summer.
The new bridge is not [ ____ ] to handle the heavy traffic during rush hour.
The divers found [ ____ ] in the samples that they had collected from the bottom of the lake.
It was [ ____ ] a moving, eloquent speech that many people in the audience were in tears.

arrange.ko: 대부분의 학생들은 시험 기간 동안 하룻밤에 일곱 시간 넘게 자는 것이 어렵다고 생각한다.
arrange.bogi: difficult / to sleep more than seven hours a night during the exam period. / most students / find it
arrange.ans: Most students find it difficult to sleep more than seven hours a night during the exam period.

arrange.ko: 높은 점수가 반드시 네가 그 과목을 잘 이해한다는 뜻은 아니다.
arrange.bogi: the subject well. / that you understand / does not necessarily mean / a high score
arrange.ans: A high score does not necessarily mean that you understand the subject well.

arrange.ko: 그 선생님은 마치 “조용히 해.”라고 말하려는 듯 손가락을 입술에 갖다 댔다.
arrange.bogi: as if to say, “Be quiet.” / the teacher / to her lips / put her finger
arrange.ans: The teacher put her finger to her lips as if to say, “Be quiet.”

arrange.ko: 알고리즘은 우리가 보는 것과 우리가 받는 선택지를 골라 줌으로써 우리를 특정한 길로 이끈다.
arrange.bogi: and what options we receive. / algorithms nudge us towards particular paths / by curate what we see
arrange.ans: Algorithms nudge us towards particular paths by curating what we see and what options we receive.

arrange.ko: 한가한 순간을 깊은 자기 성찰에 쓰는 사람들은 자신의 감정을 더 분명하게 이해할 수 있다.
arrange.bogi: their own feelings more clear. / people who use idle moments for deep self-reflection / can understand
arrange.ans: People who use idle moments for deep self-reflection can understand their own feelings more clearly.

arrange.ko: Ridge는 그 남자가 왜 전화 대신 문자를 보내 달라고 했는지 궁금했다.
arrange.bogi: instead of a call. / why the man had asked / Ridge wonder / for a text
arrange.ans: Ridge wondered why the man had asked for a text instead of a call.

arrange.ko: 선택이 이루어지는 환경의 설계는 사람들이 내리는 결정에 크게 영향을 미칠 수 있다.
arrange.bogi: the decisions people make. / in which choices are made / can significant influence / the design of the environment
arrange.ans: The design of the environment in which choices are made can significantly influence the decisions people make.

translate.en: The man held up his index finger as if to say, “Hold on.”
translate.ko: 그 남자는 마치 “잠깐만요.”라고 말하려는 듯 검지손가락을 들어 올렸다. / NEW 그 늙은 개는 저녁 식사 후에 간식을 하나 더 달라고 하려는 듯 나를 올려다보며 꼬리를 흔들었다.

translate.en: Thus, it is paramount to utilize idle moments for profound self-reflection.
translate.ko: 그러므로 한가한 순간을 깊은 자기 성찰에 활용하는 것이 가장 중요하다. / NEW 매 수업 후 하루 안에 필기를 복습하는 것이 중요하다.

translate.en: (A) Ridge was a high school student who wanted to major in music in college.
translate.ko: Ridge는 대학에서 음악을 전공하기를 원하는 고등학생이었다.

translate.en: For weeks, on his balcony, every night he listened to a man playing the guitar in the apartment across the courtyard.
translate.ko: 몇 주 동안, 자신의 발코니에서, 매일 밤 그는 마당 건너편 아파트에서 한 남자가 기타를 연주하는 것을 들었다.

translate.en: Although the songs the man played were all new to Ridge, he somehow managed to attach his own made-up lyrics to them.
translate.ko: 그 남자가 연주한 곡들은 Ridge에게 모두 생소했지만, 그는 어떻게든 그것들에 자신이 직접 만든 가사를 붙여 냈다.

translate.en: (B) His phone number and “Text me” were written on the sheet.
translate.ko: 그 종이에는 그의 전화번호와 “나에게 문자 보내요.”라는 말이 적혀 있었다.

translate.en: Then he flipped the paper over and wrote, “I have a question.”
translate.ko: 그러고 나서 그는 종이를 뒤집어 “질문이 있어요.”라고 썼다.

translate.en: Curious about the man’s question, and wondering why he had asked for a text instead of a call, Ridge pulled out his phone and entered the number.
translate.ko: 그 남자의 질문에 호기심을 느끼고, 왜 그가 전화 대신 문자를 요청했는지 궁금해져서, Ridge는 휴대폰을 꺼내 번호를 입력했다.

translate.en: The man texted, “I want to know how you’re singing lyrics to my songs when I haven’t even added lyrics to them yet.”
translate.ko: “아직 가사를 붙이지도 않았는데 당신이 어떻게 내 노래에 맞춰 가사를 노래하고 있는지 알고 싶어요.”라고 그 남자가 문자를 보냈다.

translate.en: (C) While Ridge was singing along to the music, the man suddenly stopped playing.
translate.ko: Ridge가 그 음악에 따라 노래를 부르는 동안, 그 남자는 갑자기 연주를 멈췄다.

translate.en: He had never stopped in the middle of a song, so naturally Ridge looked in his direction.
translate.ko: 그는 한 번도 곡 중간에 멈춘 적이 없었기에 자연스럽게 Ridge는 그가 있는 쪽을 바라보았다.

translate.en: He lifted one sheet of paper, and Ridge narrowed his eyes to get a good look at what was written on it.
translate.ko: 그는 종이 한 장을 들어 올렸고, Ridge는 거기에 무엇이 적혀 있는지 잘 보기 위해 눈을 가늘게 떴다.

translate.en: (D) One night, Ridge slid open the balcony door and stepped outside.
translate.ko: 어느 날 밤, Ridge는 발코니 문을 밀어 열고 밖으로 나갔다.

translate.en: He told his mom he was going out to the balcony to do his homework.
translate.ko: 그는 엄마에게 숙제를 하러 발코니에 나가는 것이라고 말했다.

translate.en: The man was playing the guitar on his balcony as usual and Ridge started to mindlessly follow the rhythm.
translate.ko: 그 남자는 평소대로 발코니에서 기타를 연주했고, Ridge는 아무 생각 없이 그 리듬을 따라가기 시작했다.
